evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: The analysis of equilibrated configurations reveals that Ni plays a key role in suppressing anti-site defect formation, thereby enhancing the stability of the γ’ phase. In addition, short range order (SRO) phenomena were observed within the γ’ phase, further stabilizing the γ’ phase.
